RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel can indicate affinity or unconscious bias, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination. For a "head of" role, institutions often prioritize regulatory experience, stakeholder management, and leadership over technical depth like a PhD. 

Directly alleging sex discrimination without concrete evidence carries substantial professional and reputational risk. It depends on whether the bank violated internal diversity policies requiring mixed panels, or if you intend to pursue a legal grievance. 

Start by sending a polite follow-up regarding your requested feedback, focusing strictly on competencies and selection criteria. If the response is evasive, contradictory, or non-job-related, consult an employment lawyer before formally raising bias.
